    The XML Signature and Encryption algorithm URIs accepted, replacing the defaults (IIP-ALG08): SHA-2 digests, RSA and ECDSA with SHA-2, AES-GCM and AES-CBC, RSA-OAEP.

    Lets providers registered at runtime publish metadata on private or loopback addresses and plain http: development only, since otherwise registering one is a request forgery against the server's own network.

    How far apart this server's clock and a provider's may be; 3 minutes by default (SAML2Int SDP-G01).
